title: Iranian president says Iran is open to diplomacy but will defend its interests in Hormuz
description: It is Iran's turn at the UN with Iran Pres. Pezeshkian taking the stage today. Note that US officials walked out of the UNGA hall ahead of his speech.  In summary, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Iran needs nuclear energy, not a nuclear bomb, and argued that the nuclear issue cannot be settled on the battlefield. He said Iran has shown a commitment to negotiations, but will not surrender to military pressure. title: Iranian official says reopening the Strait of Hormuz was discussed in U.S. talks
description: A senior Iranian official told Reuters about Tuesday’s indirect talks with the United States: Reopening the Strait of Hormuz and lifting the U.S. blockade were discussed. Iran’s key priorities are permanently ending hostilities and lifting the U.S. naval blockade. Still many differences remain between Iran, US positions, but diplomacy continues Meanwhile Secretary of State Rubio adds that talks on Iran on Tuesday were largely an exchange of ideas and messages.
